instruction: Use the Autodesk Fusion 360 GUI in the Manufacture workspace. Open the initial file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\turned_shaft.step. Create a turning setup for the shaft with the turning axis along Z. Generate OD rough turning, OD finish turning, grooving, and center drilling operations. Tool definitions: T1 is an OD rough turning tool, T2 is an OD finish turning tool, and T3 is a grooving/center drilling tool as required by the operations. In the NC Program or post-process dialog, use metric units and the selected post processor for this setup, then export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-16.nc to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths.
source: Fusion Setup 与 NC Program 文档。(Autodesk) https://www.autodesk.com/learn/ondemand/tutorial/create-a-setup-in-fusion-for-milling?utm_source=chatgpt.com
